{"id":2041978389,"question_id":4274,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 month","timestamp":1782121267,"status":15,"status_display":"Runtime Error","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/2041978389/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Maximum Total Value","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int maxTotalValue(vector<int>& value, vector<int>& decay, int m) {\n        priority_queue<tuple<int,int,int>>pq;\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<value.size() ; i++) pq.push({value[i] , 1 , i});\n\n        int total_gain = 0;\n\n        while(m-- and !pq.empty())\n        {\n            auto[val , freq , index] = pq.top();\n            pq.pop();\n\n            total_gain += val;\n\n            int resultant = (val - decay[index]);\n\n            if(resultant > 0) pq.push({resultant , freq+1 , index});\n        }\n        return total_gain;\n    } \n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"maximum-total-value","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2207}
